note: Themed baskets: equal-weight groups of stocks for ideas no single ETF captures. A watchlist, not recorded ideas. Members come from IBKR's theme data (search_investment_topics / get_theme_details) and the dossier; every member is checked with IBKR (search_contracts for a US listing, get_price_snapshot avg_90d_usd_volume of at least about $20M; names in the standard universe skip the volume check). The snapshot is IBKR's change from the prior close at the time shown; after 16:00 it includes after-hours trades. Members added 2026-11-12 come from the widened universe (universe.INDEX_STOCKS: S&P 500 and 400 names trading at least $20M a day on our Yahoo bars), so like other universe names they skip the IBKR volume check and have no snapshot until the next refresh. Since 2026-11-16 every basket must pass the cohesion test (`fr baskets check`, basket_check.py): over the last 120 sessions, each member's daily return after removing its hedge's part correlates at least 0.25 with the rest of the basket's, and the basket averages at least 0.35. Re-run monthly and before adding a basket. On 2026-11-16 the S&P 500 was sorted into industry baskets from its GICS sub-industries (with S&P 400 peers where a group needed a third name); a group or member that failed the cohesion test was left out, so about a sixth of the index is in no basket and is screened as single stocks only.

baskets.story: Power generators and retailers whose growth case leans on ERCOT data-center load. A Texas data-center moratorium, which the governor's race put on the table, hits them directly; regulated utilities elsewhere (XLU) far less.
baskets.watch: Texas count and any statement from the governor-elect or PUCT on large-load interconnection; ERCOT large-load queue updates.
baskets.source: IBKR theme Data Center Power; dossier 2026-11-03

Houston-based; the largest ERCOT retail supplier with Texas generation

baskets.name: Genomics and diagnostics
baskets.story: Labs that read DNA from a blood or tissue sample: prenatal screening, cancer screening, matching cancer patients to drugs and catching a cancer's return early (minimal residual disease, MRD). They trade on test volumes, on Medicare and insurer coverage of each test, and on the race for MRD, where Natera leads and sues rivals over patents. Against XLV, the spread separates the testing story from insurers, drug makers and tools makers.
baskets.watch: Quarterly test volumes and average selling prices, Medicare (MolDX) coverage decisions and payer wins, MRD study readouts and guideline changes, patent rulings between Natera and its rivals, FDA rules for lab-developed tests.

baskets.name: Design and analytics software

baskets.watch: Software earnings and guidance, chip-design spending, AI competition, government contracts.
baskets.source: S&P 500 industry group (GICS sub-industries), kept after the cohesion check of 2026-11-16

baskets.source: S&P 500 industry group (GICS sub-industries), kept after the cohesion check of 2026-11-16

baskets.name: PC and server hardware

baskets.source: S&P 500 industry group (GICS sub-industries), kept after the cohesion check of 2026-11-16
